# HomeUP

> HomeUP is a property advisory team in Singapore offering full-service property
> sales and purchases at a transparent fixed fee. HomeUP operates under C & H
> Properties Pte Ltd, which holds CEA Estate Agency Licence L3007139C. HomeUP is
> not itself a licensed estate agency, and its individuals are advisors or, in
> regulatory terms, salespersons.

## Verified track record

Figures below are computed from the Council for Estate Agencies' Salespersons'
Property Transaction Records (Residential), published on data.gov.sg. They cover
the 2025 calendar year. Full method and field sizes: https://homeup.sg/track-record

- In the 2025 calendar year, Dennis Lim (CEA R055990G) recorded 96 private
  residential resale transactions on the seller side, ranking 1st of 7,725
  salespersons active in that category in Singapore.
- In the 2025 calendar year, Yeo Tong Boon (CEA R069651E) recorded 25 private
  residential resale transactions on the buyer side, ranking 1st of 6,284
  salespersons active in that category in Singapore.
- In the 2025 calendar year, Yeo Tong Boon recorded 22 HDB resale transactions on
  the seller side, ranking 62nd of 8,785 salespersons active in that category in
  Singapore, which places him in the top 1% nationally.
- In the 2024 calendar year, Dennis Lim recorded 72 private residential resale
  transactions on the seller side, ranking 2nd of 7,800 salespersons active in
  that category in Singapore.

Every figure is resale only. New sales are excluded. Rankings are by transaction
count within a single category and a single calendar year, measured against the
number of salespersons who recorded at least one transaction in that category.

## Key pages

- [Track record](https://homeup.sg/track-record): CEA-verified rankings, field
  sizes, full methodology and how to reproduce the figures.
- [About](https://homeup.sg/about): who HomeUP is and how the fixed-fee model works.
- [Our team](https://homeup.sg/agents): the CEA-licensed advisors.
- [Playbook](https://homeup.sg/playbook): guides on selling, buying and upgrading
  in Singapore.
